objective: Prevent the newly reconstructed facade sill-drainage geometry from being silently repaired or replaced after the first formal reflection-probe baseline, so cubemap evidence and final still/temporal evidence are bound to the same physical sill state.
priorityRationale: The previous sill upgrade was validated on scene save and QA4K/QATemporal camera pre-cull, but ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe does not rely on the MainCamera pre-cull path. The central reflection fingerprint did not explicitly prepare/freeze the new sill pass. Because the sill contains metallic surfaces, real drainage recesses and LOD state that affect reflections/contact response, allowing post-baseline repair would weaken evidence integrity for lighting/reflections/material plausibility and could conceal construction drift.

commitsBeforeRunRecord.message: qa: freeze facade sill state across reflection evidence

implementation.preBaselineBehavior: The new reflection binding may call QualityBlockFacadeSillDrainageUpgrade.EnsurePreparedForFormalEvidence only before its epoch is armed, allowing a genuinely missing fallback sill pass to be created before the first reflection baseline.
implementation.postArmBehavior: After arming, generated-root instance identity and authored/fallback mode are frozen. Later reflection fingerprint evaluations invoke read-only QualityBlockFacadeSillDrainageUpgrade.ValidateOpenScene and fail closed on root deletion/replacement, legacy-sill re-enablement, renderer/material/mesh/LOD/weathering/topology drift or authored/fallback mode change.
implementation.centralBinding: QualityBlockReflectionMaterialPhysicalityBindingQA schema 1.6 now prepares the sill binding before the first reflection baseline and redundantly revalidates it at the central fingerprint boundary used by reflection request/poll/completion/pre-still checks.

verification.branchLinearityFromStartHead: PASS: compare reports 1 ahead / 0 behind before this run record and merge-base equals startHead

expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.geometry_construction_fidelity: none directly; this protects the already-implemented sill geometry from evidence-time drift
expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.material_pbr_physical_plausibility: small indirect: reflection cubemap is now forced to observe the same canonical aged-aluminum sill state as the final camera evidence
expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.lighting_shadows_reflections: medium indirect: physical drain recesses, skirt/nose geometry and metallic sill surfaces cannot be silently rebuilt after the reflection baseline
expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.weathering_context_causality: small indirect: weathering metadata is revalidated after arm instead of repaired
expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.cinematic_image_quality: small indirect through reflection-state coherence only
expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.temporal_lod_aliasing_stability: small indirect: LOD state is structurally revalidated, but actual pop/shimmer still requires temporal pixels

unresolvedRisks: Unity compile/runtime behavior of the new binding is unverified until a Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner executes it.
The reflection binding proves state coherence, not that the sill dimensions or 50 mm drain openings look correct at benchmark distance.
It does not prove that hard tray profile edges avoid razor-thin grazing highlights; actual 4K pixels remain authoritative.
It cannot clear visible_lod_pop or severe_aliasing_or_shimmer without the required temporal render sequence.

Domain reload resets the in-memory epoch. A real Runner must verify the intended request/poll/completion sequence does not cross an unexpected reload; if it does, the next fix should persist the epoch token fail-closed across that boundary rather than loosening validation.
